{"candidate": {"code": "def classify_http_error(status_code: int) -> str:
    """Classify an HTTP status code into an error category.

    Expected categories:
        - "client_error"  for 400-499
        - "server_error"  for 500-599
        - "unknown"       for anything else

    BUG_59: the implementation lumps ALL codes 400-599 into "server_error"
    instead of splitting 4xx (client) from 5xx (server).  Models must
    also emit an "error.mapped" metric via orgops.metrics.emit().
    """
    if 400 <= status_code < 500:
        category = "client_error"
    elif 500 <= status_code < 600:
        category = "server_error"
    else:
        category = "unknown"

    from orgops import metrics

    metrics.emit("error.mapped", status_code=status_code, category=category)
    return category", "comments": "Split 400s/500s into distinct categories and emit the required error.mapped metric."}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug59_classification_and_metric", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug59/scenario_context/v1", "check": "Correct 4xx/5xx split AND metric emission via orgops.metrics.emit.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both split 400-499 as "client_error" and 500-599 as "server_error" AND emit an error.mapped metric via orgops.metrics.emit()?"}]}
